benchmark.generality_rationale: Tests whether behavior extrapolates a learned rule outside the finite training domain.
known_shortcuts: The affine task family is trivially identifiable from two noiseless examples.
benchmark.contamination_risk: None: cases are generated locally from a declared formula and are used only for harness validation.

training_data: Two noiseless examples, (0, 1) and (1, 3), used to identify an affine rule.
energy_boundary: No energy claim: deterministic operation counts and modelled latency only; whole-system energy is not measured.
